params.comment: The Pages tab reads this repo's public page, the Quality page, at its Pages URL (the live site, built by .github/workflows/pages.yml). origin is the production URL; site_dir stays empty because the build writes quality/dist after the readings.
The usability metrics read the site from this entry: origin and site_dir match design.raw_hex. key_pages are the two pages the repo ships.
platform pages reads GitHub Pages deploys through the GitHub API.
